scope: All saved PubChem, RxNorm and MeSH query/record collections; separate outputs with links to prepared DSLD occurrences
normalization: Preserve source values and types; add separate trimmed display/search fields and explicit missing-field states. Do not infer synonyms as equivalence.
pubchem: All collected compound properties and source synonyms; query/request/batch provenance
rxnorm: Basic concept properties, NAMES/SOURCES properties and UNII_CODE/DRUGBANK/SNOMEDCT cross-reference candidates; other properties retained in raw only
mesh: Matched records, described subjects, complete typed saved RDF statements and term-concept-record bindings; preserved context is not an activated clinical or identity relation
review: All returned candidates remain needs_review with null confidence. No-match and ambiguous queries retained. Do not overwrite earlier bounded-pilot decisions.
references: External RDF targets remain explicit and unresolved outside described subjects; no network expansion
validation: All 3391 query occurrences per source link to prepared DSLD
Typed RDF and source pointer preservation
No identity approvals or graph mutations
